    push ebx

    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    mov ecx, esi
    call 0x446220
    mov edi, eax

    test eax, eax
    jns live_finish
    mov edx, eax
    neg edx
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x0c], edx
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]

    push 0
    push dword ptr [esi + 0x38]
    push dword ptr [ebx + 0x132C0]
    mov ecx, ebx
    call 0x5a3fd0
    test eax, eax
    je live_finish
    cmp eax, esi
    jne live_finish

    push 0
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x0c]
    push eax
    mov ecx, ebx
    call 0x639cf5

live_finish:
    mov eax, edi
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    mov esp, ebp
    pop ebp
    ret 0x0C

dead_stack:
    push ebp
    mov ebp, esp
    push ebx
    push esi
    mov esi, ecx
    cmp dword ptr [esi + 0x60], 0
    jle dead_finish

    push 0

    push dword ptr [ebx + 0x132C0]
    mov ecx, ebx
    call 0x5a3fd0
    test eax, eax
    je dead_finish
    cmp eax, esi
    jne dead_finish

    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]

target_resolver_gate:
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    cmp edx, 0x25

    shl edx, 4
    lea ecx, [edx + ecx + 0x1C4]

    call eax
    test eax, eax
    jnz resolver_return_living
    pop ecx

    cmp dword ptr [ebp + 0x18], 0
    jne resolver_zero
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    cmp edx, dword ptr [ecx + 0x132C0]
    jne resolver_zero

    test eax, eax
    jz resolver_zero

    cmp eax, 0x19
    je resolver_corpse
    cmp eax, 0xAA

    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    mov eax, 0x5a3fd0
    call eax
    pop ebp
